comments.author: Chester
comments.body:
They're talking about special production tech. 1 in the 2 star college (advanced).

you get 5 points for using an alchemy or linguistic recipe, but you get 15 points for getting a great success in ANY basic production (storage, cooking, etc)

works extremely well if you can do the chicken-to-egg-to-chicken trick.

I used this back when oxford first came out to grind out my 100 theses and then to help unlock the 4-star college.

General check when combined with grinding evasion out in the caribbean is a lot faster, but you better have a boat with good dura, this is an entirely seperate discussion anyway.
